content.title: Which Supermarkets Are Open Over Easter Weekend? Full List 2026
content.text: If you’re planning a last-minute Easter food shop, here’s the short version: most large UK supermarkets will be closed on Easter Sunday, 5 April 2026. Good Friday (3 April) and Easter Monday (6 April) usually bring reduced or location-specific hours. Always check your local store before you leave! We’ve pulled together the latest supermarkets Easter opening times 2026 info we could confirm. Where national hours haven’t been published, we’ve flagged that clearly so you’re not caught out. TL;DR: Supermarket Easter Opening Times 2026 Supermarket Good Friday Easter Saturday Easter Sunday Easter Monday ASDA Check local store Check local store Large stores usually closed Check local store Sainsbury’s Check local store Check local store Large stores usually closed Check local store Tesco Check local store Usually normal Large stores usually closed Check local store Morrisons Check local store Check local store Large stores usually closed Check local store Aldi Check local store Check local store Closed (England and Wales) Check local store Lidl 08:00 – 22:00 08:00 – 22:00 Closed 09:00 – 21:00 M&S Check local store Check local store Most stores closed Check local store Waitrose Check local store Usually normal Most stores closed Check local store The golden rule: Easter Sunday trading laws in England and Wales require all shops over 280 square metres to close. That covers the vast majority of large supermarkets. Always check your exact branch before you go! Easter 2026 Dates to Know Before you start planning the big shop, here are the key dates for Easter weekend 2026: Good Friday: 3 April 2026 (Bank Holiday) Easter Saturday: 4 April 2026 Easter Sunday: 5 April 2026 Easter Monday: 6 April 2026 (Bank Holiday in England, Wales and Northern Ireland) Note for Scottish shoppers: Easter Monday is not a bank holiday in Scotland, and Sunday trading laws differ north of the border, meaning more stores may stay open on Easter Sunday than in England and Wales. Supermarket Easter Opening Times 2026: Store by Store Here’s everything we know right now for each of the major supermarkets. We’ve been straight about what’s confirmed and what still needs a local check! ASDA Easter Opening Times 2026 ASDA has not published a single national Easter 2026 timetable across all store types that we could verify at time of writing. The safest advice is to check your local ASDA store page before travelling. What we can say with confidence: All 580 large ASDA stores are typically closed on Easter Sunday due to UK trading laws Smaller ASDA Express stores, petrol forecourts and Scottish stores may stay open Good Friday and Easter Monday hours vary by branch and region If ASDA is your go-to for the big Easter shop, get your shop done on Friday or Saturday to be safe! Sainsbury’s Easter Opening Times 2026 Sainsbury’s is pointing shoppers to its store locator rather than publishing one national Easter timetable. Hours vary by branch, but the general pattern is: Large supermarkets are likely to be shut on Easter Sunday in England, Wales and Northern Ireland Scottish stores typically remain open on Easter Sunday Good Friday and Easter Monday hours will differ by location Use the Sainsbury’s store locator to check your nearest branch before heading out. Tesco Easter Opening Times 2026 Tesco has confirmed it will close most large stores on Easter Sunday. Reduced hours apply across the bank holiday weekend. Store size makes a big difference here: Good Friday (3 April): Large stores open from 06:00 – 22:00 (England and Wales) Easter Saturday (4 April): Normal trading hours Easter Sunday (5 April): All Tesco Extra and Superstores closed in England, Wales and Northern Ireland; most Express stores stay open Easter Monday (6 April): Large stores open from 08:00 – 18:00 (England and Wales) Scotland follows different rules, with large stores open on Easter Sunday. Always use the Tesco store finder to confirm your local branch. Morrisons Easter Opening Times 2026 Morrisons has not published a confirmed national Easter 2026 opening-hours schedule at time of writing. Their own guidance is to check your nearest store directly. The expected pattern based on previous years: Easter Sunday: large stores closed in England and Wales Good Friday and Easter Monday: possible reduced hours Use the Morrisons store finder to check before you go. Aldi Easter Opening Times 2026 Aldi’s store finder confirms Easter Sunday 2026 falls on 5 April, with large stores in England and Wales closed on Easter Sunday due to Sunday trading laws. For the rest of the weekend, hours can vary by branch, so it’s worth a quick check before setting off. The general expected pattern: Good Friday: Open (typically 08:00 – 22:00) Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Closed in England and Wales; Scottish stores may open Easter Monday: Open with reduced hours (typically 08:00 – 20:00) Find your nearest store using the Aldi store locator. Lidl Easter Opening Times 2026 Lidl is the standout here, with confirmed 2026 Easter opening hours already published! Here’s what to expect at most Lidl stores: Good Friday (3 April): 08:00 – 22:00 Holy Saturday (4 April): 08:00 – 22:00 Easter Sunday (5 April): Closed Easter Monday (6 April): 09:00 – 21:00 Even with confirmed national hours, Lidl still recommends checking your local store for the most accurate times, as some locations may differ. M&S Easter Opening Times 2026 Marks and Spencer is showing store-level Easter 2026 opening hours on individual branch pages rather than one blanket national schedule. Some M&S stores are already showing Easter weekend hours, including: Easter Sunday (5 April): Closed at most branches Easter Monday (6 April): Reduced hours at many stores This is not just any Easter food shop, this is an M&S Easter food shop – so make sure you check your local M&S store page before heading out! Waitrose Easter Opening Times 2026 Waitrose has not yet published a confirmed national Easter 2026 schedule. Based on the consistent pattern from previous years, most stores are expected to follow: Good Friday: 08:00 – 20:00 at most branches Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Most larger stores closed; some Little Waitrose branches may remain open Easter Monday: 08:00 – 20:00 at most branches Some Little Waitrose shops, Shell forecourt stores and Welcome Break locations may have different or extended hours. Check the Waitrose store locator before your visit. Our Top Tips for Easter Weekend Shopping Don’t get caught out with an empty fridge and a closed supermarket! Here’s our quick checklist before Easter weekend: Shop on Friday or Saturday rather than leaving it to Sunday, when most large stores will be shut Check your exact branch, not just the brand’s homepage, as hours can vary significantly between stores Use the store locator links we’ve included above for the most up-to-date local information Have a back-up plan in mind, whether that’s a smaller convenience store or a different supermarket nearby Scotland shoppers have more flexibility, as Sunday trading laws do not apply in the same way We’ll keep this page updated as more supermarkets confirm their 2026 Easter hours, so check back closer to the weekend!
